title: DiffER$^2$: Diffusion Ensembles for Retrosynthesis Prediction with SMILES Adapted Particle Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.33557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational retrosynthesis prediction has the potential to reduce development time for newly discovered drugs by automatically generating potential reactions for a target product. Data-driven approaches commonly treat this as a sequence-to-sequence generation task on SMILES strings. In this work, we construct ensembles of discrete-time and continuous-time diffusion models for molecular generation and incorporate guidance mechanisms for improved output diversity. We propose an adaptation of particle guidance to SMILES sequence generation which significantly improves the number of unique molecules generated by diffusion ensembles while increasing top-k accuracy. These results further expand the efficacy of discrete diffusion for SMILES generation, and our empirical analyses offer new insights into the capabilities of diffusion models for chemical retrosynthesis.

translated_title: DiffER²：基于SMILES适配粒子引导的扩散集成逆合成预测方法
translated_abstract: 计算逆合成预测有望通过自动生成目标产物的潜在反应来缩短新药的研发时间。数据驱动方法通常将该任务视为SMILES字符串上的序列到序列生成任务。在本工作中，我们构建了用于分子生成的离散时间和连续时间扩散模型集成，并引入引导机制以提高输出多样性。我们提出了将粒子引导适配到SMILES序列生成的方法，该方法在显著提高扩散集成所生成的独特分子数量的同时，还提升了top-k准确率。这些结果进一步扩展了离散扩散在SMILES生成中的有效性，我们的实证分析也为扩散模型在化学逆合成中的能力提供了新的见解。
tldr: 本文提出将粒子引导适配到SMILES序列生成的扩散模型集成方法DiffER²，显著提升了逆合成预测中生成独特分子的数量和top-k准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DiffER², which adapts particle guidance to SMILES sequence generation in diffusion model ensembles, significantly improving the number of unique molecules generated and top-k accuracy for retrosynthesis prediction.
